title: Reliability and lifecycle
description: Advisory status, confidence, effective-time, review, contradiction, and replacement signals for maintained knowledge.

fields.label: Lifecycle
fields.description: Authored lifecycle state: draft, active, deprecated, superseded, or retired.

fields.label: Confidence
fields.description: An authored assessment from 0 to 1. Studio does not verify the claim.

fields.label: Effective from
fields.description: ISO date or timestamp when the knowledge begins to apply.

fields.label: Effective until
fields.description: ISO date or timestamp after which the knowledge no longer applies.

fields.label: Review after
fields.description: ISO date or timestamp after which a maintainer should review this concept.

fields.label: Superseded by
fields.description: Bundle concept IDs that replace this concept.

fields.label: Contradicts
fields.description: Bundle concept IDs whose authored claims conflict with this concept.

relationships.label: Supersedes
relationships.description: This concept replaces the target while preserving its history.

relationships.label: Contradicts
relationships.description: The concepts make claims that a reader should inspect together.
